tha-ap134:1.1: vinatā nadiyā → vitatthānadiyā (bj) | vinatā → vitthatāya (sya-all) | vitatthānadiyā → vitthatāyanadī (bj: PTS); cinatā (bj: machasaṁ, sīmu); vitthatāya (bj: syā) | nadiyā → vitthatāya nadiyā (cck: syā.)
tha-ap134:1.2: pilakkhu phalito → milakkhuphalino (sya-all) | pilakkho → pilakkhu (bj: machasaṁ) | pilakkhu → pilakkho (cck: sī. theragāthā aṭṭha.)
tha-ap134:3.3: abhipūjemi → abhipūsiṁ (sya-all) | abhipūjemi → S1 abhipūjesi. (pts note)
tha-ap134:3.4: mahāmuni → G. S1 buddhaseṭṭhaṁ mahāmuniṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap134:4.2: pilakkhumaddasaṁ → pilakkhaṁ addasaṁ (bj, pts); milakkhuṁ addasaṁ (sya-all) | pilakkhaṁ → pilakkhuṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | pilakkhaṁ → G. S1 milakkhuṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap134:4.3: paṭiladdhomhi → paṭiladdhombhi (bj) | paññaṁ → saññaṁ (sya-all) | paññaṁ ñāṇapūjāyidaṁ → saññaṁ ñāṇapūjāy idaṁ (pts) | paññaṁ → saññaṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu, syā) | paññaṁ → taṁ saññaṁ (cck: syā.); taṁ puññaṁ (cck: ka.) | saññaṁ → G. paññaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap134:6.2: phaluggatā → baluggatā (sya-all) | dvādasāsuṁ phaluggatā → dvādas āsuṁ khaluggatā (pts) | Khaluggatā → G. baluggatā; S1 khalugatā. (pts note)
